subject.title: fix: forward response-frame meta to clients

question: Should this PR add optional top-level `res.meta` to the existing v4 Gateway response envelope after it is rebased?
rationale: The code fix is narrow and source-backed, but changing a public protocol envelope can affect strict generated clients, so maintainers must own whether this is acceptable as additive v4 behavior or needs a different compatibility shape.

options.title: Accept additive v4 metadata
options.body: Rebase the PR, keep the optional field/docs/generated Swift defaults/tests, and treat `res.meta` as an accepted additive v4 response-envelope field.

options.title: Version or gate metadata
options.body: Require the PR to introduce a version-gated or alternate metadata contract before clients can see a new top-level response field.

options.title: Pause this protocol change
options.body: Keep the linked issue open while maintainers choose a different client-visible metadata design.

recommendation.title: Accept additive v4 metadata
recommendation.body: Rebase the PR, keep the optional field/docs/generated Swift defaults/tests, and treat `res.meta` as an accepted additive v4 response-envelope field.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent is the strongest current signal for the protocol/schema and gateway responder surfaces touched by the decision.
